labels.name: needs-research
labels.description: Bot routing: feature needs research. Human promotes with research-factory.
labels.lifecycle: Exactly one needs-* per issue, with triaged. Not consumed; factory trigger is separate.

labels.name: needs-reproduction
labels.description: Bot routing: bug needs reproduction. Human promotes with reproducer-factory.

labels.name: needs-spec
labels.description: Bot routing: ready for OpenSpec. Human promotes with change-factory.
labels.lifecycle: Exactly one needs-* per issue, with triaged. Not consumed; factory trigger is separate.

labels.name: needs-human
labels.description: Bot routing: needs human judgment; not auto-promoted to a factory.
labels.lifecycle: Exactly one needs-* per issue, with triaged. Stays until a human re-routes.

labels.name: triaged
labels.description: Sticky marker: classifier or scanner already routed; skip re-classify.
labels.applied_by: issue-classifier (bot) or scanners when filing issues
labels.lifecycle: Sticky. Applied with one needs-* (classifier) or with a topic label (scanners). Never a factory trigger.

labels.name: research-factory
